<script>
var INVALID_EMAIL = "Invalid E-Mail";
var DUPLICATE_EMAIL = "E-Mail already added";
$(document).foundation({
  dropdown: {
    active_class: 'open'
  }
});
$(document).ready(function() {
    $("#btn_monthlysubscribe").click(function() {
        $.post("/xdc/json/monthly_blogsubscribe", {
                email: $("#email").val(),
                language: ""
            },
            function(resText) {
                if (resText.length > 0) {
                    var obj = jQuery.parseJSON(resText);
                    if (obj.status == "1") {
                        $(".footer-newsletter-form").hide();
                        $(".footer-newsletter-confirm").fadeIn().removeClass("hide");
                        $("#email").next("p.error").html("");
                        $("#email").next("p.error").hide();
                    } else {
                        $(".footer-newsletter-form").show();
                        $(".footer-newsletter-confirm").addClass("hide");
                        for (var i = 0; i < obj.errorMessages.length; i++) {
                            if(obj.errorMessages[i].field == "email") {
                                if(obj.errorMessages[i].errormessage == "-1") {
                                    $("#email").next("p.error").html(INVALID_EMAIL);
                                } else if(obj.errorMessages[i].errormessage == "-2") {
                                    $("#email").next("p.error").html(DUPLICATE_EMAIL);
                                }
                            } else {
                                $("#" + obj.errorMessages[i].field).next("p.error").html(obj.errorMessages[i].errormessage);
                            }
                            $("#" + obj.errorMessages[i].field).next("p.error").show();
                        }
                    }
                }
            });
        return false;
    });
});
</script>
